name: Bleu de Chanel
description: Bleu de Chanel is a timeless and sophisticated fragrance that opens with a burst of vibrant citrus and fresh aromatic notes. A blend of crisp spices adds energy and refinement, while warm amber and rich woods create depth and character. Subtle smoky and balsamic undertones lend an air of mystery, softened by a smooth powdery finish. Fresh, elegant, and confidently masculine, Bleu de Chanel leaves a lasting impression of effortless luxury.
